svg.title: Hybrid RAG & int8 vector search in Cloudflare D1 + NotebookDO
svg.desc: Five-stage pipeline: 1. browser chunking, 2. 768d embeddings and symmetric int8 quantization, 3. storage in D1 + FTS5 index, 4. hybrid search via NotebookDO in-memory dot product and D1 FTS5 BM25 with Reciprocal Rank Fusion, 5. citation-validated SSE chat.

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hybrid RAG pipeline: 768d int8 quantization + D1 FTS5 BM25 + Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF)

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', system-ui, -apple-system, Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 75 % less storage than Float32 · 0 ms Worker CPU load for vector scoring · Recall@10 ≥ 0.98
